entries.40992ff69289097c: This business division handles prepared frozen foods such as side dishes, frozen vegetables, fried fish, fish paste products and marine products. It develops products in tie-ups with contract manufacturers, and develops and sells PB products through direct negotiations with major users. Sales (by business) for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥13,898 million.
entries.5bf8de02e61c20fd: This is the company's core business division, handling "boneless fish" from which all fish bones have been removed, for medical and nursing-care meals.
entries.61af61222cdca103: A business division that handles prepared frozen foods such as side dishes, frozen vegetables, fried fish, fish paste products, and marine products.
entries.7583b97362b313cf: This is the company's core business division, handling "boneless fish" from which all fish bones have been removed, for medical and nursing-care meals. The company succeeded in developing it in 1998 and holds four manufacturing patents for its processing technology. X-ray inspection for residual bones is carried out, and as of March 2026 it offers 32 fish species. Revenue by business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,713 million.
entries.7bd620e5422beab1: This is a business division handling livestock meat products that apply the processing technology of "boneless fish."
entries.8918686ed53ed7a7: End users such as medical meal providers, bento caterers and restaurants
entries.900f962d31a1084a: A company headquartered in Chuo-ku, Tokyo.
entries.9669e0bf47612ae4: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Tokyo. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements and has a single segment, the wholesale of frozen foods for commercial use. It plans frozen foods for commercial use and, as a fabless company, outsources their manufacture to partner factories in Japan and overseas that meet its own inspection standards, selling its own-brand products and PB products for specific users. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 is 146. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.cc195f08c5cc6d24: A company that plans commercial frozen foods, including boneless fish, for users such as medical-care meal providers and restaurants, entrusts their manufacture to partner factories, and sells them.
entries.e11ba647b9498f9f: This is a business division handling livestock meat products that apply the processing technology of "boneless fish." The main product is the "Rakuraku Takumi Flavor Series," which can be cooked from frozen and keeps its tenderness even when cold. Revenue by business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,441 million.
